name: content-analysis
description: Scientific content analysis for academic research. Systematic coding, codebook development, frequency analysis, and thematic reporting following established social-science methods.

interface.longDescription: Develop codebooks, code textual material, assess inter-coder reliability, identify themes, and produce structured research outputs.
defaultPrompt: Develop a codebook for these interview transcripts.
Perform an inductive content analysis of these documents.
Assess inter-coder reliability for this coded dataset.
